applicableDomain: HL7 FHIR R4 Resource Mapping, International Patient Summary (IPS) & Cross-Facility HIE Exchange
descriptionAndPurpose: Maps HealthCore MPI, encounter, allergy, medication, and verified result entities into compliant HL7 FHIR R4 Bundles and International Patient Summary (IPS) documents with cross-facility consent verification and patient identity mapping.
prerequisiteConditions: Verified cross-facility consent and MPI organization-scoped identity mapping (never blindly conflating external IDs).
safetyChecks: Blocks HIE disclosure when active patient opt-out or consent restriction applies.
Preserves source facility provenance on every FHIR resource.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Failed transmissions enter Integration Ops DLQ for deterministic replay without altering clinical source records.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs consenting patientId, receiving organization, FHIR Bundle ID, and HTTP/ATNA receipt.
completionCriteria: Valid FHIR R4 IPS Bundle transmitted and acknowledged by receiving HIE peer.
